drills.name: 2 Kicks, 1 Pull
drills.description: Take two narrow, fast kicks for every pull to emphasize line and kick timing.

drills.name: 3-3-3 Butterfly
drills.description: 3 right-arm, 3 left-arm, then 3 full-stroke butterfly cycles with a steady rhythm.

drills.name: 6-Kick Switch
drills.description: Six kicks on one side, take one stroke to rotate, then hold the other side for six kicks.

drills.name: 6-Kick Switch
drills.description: Six kicks on the side, one stroke to switch sides; maintain one goggle in the water.

drills.name: Arms-at-Sides Rotation
drills.description: Keep the head back and arms at the sides while rotating through the hips and shoulders.

drills.name: Backstroke Rotation
drills.description: Kick on the side with one arm extended; rotate through the hips and shoulders every six kicks.

drills.name: Body Dolphin
drills.description: Alternate 4–6 underwater dolphin kicks on the stomach and back; keep the kick driven from the core.

drills.name: Breaststroke Pullout
drills.description: Practice a legal, powerful pullout with a tight line before the first breakout stroke.

drills.name: Catch-Up Freestyle
drills.description: Keep the lead hand extended until the recovering hand meets it, then switch smoothly.

drills.name: Double-Arm Backstroke
drills.description: Use both arms together to reinforce a tall body line and simultaneous finish.

drills.name: Fingertip Drag
drills.description: Lightly drag the fingertips during recovery to encourage a relaxed, high-elbow return.

drills.name: Kick on Back
drills.description: Lie on the back with hands at the sides and isolate a narrow, fast breaststroke kick.

drills.name: One-Arm Streamline Back Kick
drills.description: Kick on the back with one arm in streamline, alternating right and left by 25; rotate the hips toward the streamline arm.

drills.name: Pause Breaststroke
drills.description: Pause for one count in the glide after each kick to feel the line before the next pull.

drills.name: Pull Every Third Rotation
drills.description: Maintain a steady backstroke rotation pattern and take a pull on every third rotation.

drills.name: Reach for the Sky
drills.description: Reach upward through the recovery while emphasizing balanced rotation and body position.

drills.name: Scull to Fly
drills.description: Scull through the front of the stroke, then take one controlled butterfly stroke.

drills.name: Single-Arm Backstroke
drills.description: Keep one arm at the side and use the working arm to focus on clean rotation and entry.

drills.name: Single-Arm Butterfly
drills.description: One arm stays forward while the working arm focuses on a relaxed recovery and strong catch.

drills.name: Single-Arm Freestyle
drills.description: One arm stays forward while the working arm focuses on an early vertical forearm catch.

drills.name: Streamline Kick on Back
drills.description: Hold a long streamline while kicking on the back with the head relaxed and hips high.
